chaining: a free 200K-context text model and a free vision model are a zero-cost first pass in a two-stage pipeline; only the survivors go to a metered model

free_tier.stated: Two models are free on input, output and cache, with no token cap or expiry stated: the text model GLM-4.7-Flash (200K context) and the vision model GLM-4.6V-Flash. Concurrency per model is the only published constraint and the per-model figure sits behind a login
free_tier.notes: perpetual free models; unverified: a new-user token pack shown on the login page

limits.value: concurrency, the number of requests in flight at one moment, is capped per model and per user-rights tier; the per-model figure is on a login-gated page and is unverified

binding_note: concurrency per model and per user-rights tier; platform-level throttling can apply at peak load

identity_cost.detail: registration accepts a non-mainland phone number: choose the country code and verify by SMS code. Whether API use needs real-name authentication is unverified; the FAQ names real-name authentication only for upgrading to an enterprise account

reliability_note: not assessed: no request was sent to the endpoint
confidence_note: the free-model list is the pricing page's own FAQ answer; the concurrency figure and the real-name requirement for API use are unverified
